name: Fedlex Connector
description: Search Swiss federal legislation: laws, articles, and amendments via the Fedlex SPARQL endpoint.

tools.name: search_by_title
tools.description: Search Swiss federal legislation titles in the Classified Compilation (RS/SR) on Fedlex. Use to find the RS number of a law when you know its name but not its number. Searches titles only, not article content. Returns only acts currently in force.

query.description: Keywords to match against act titles (e.g. 'code civil', 'protection des donnÃ©es')

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Retrieve a single article when you already know the EXACT article number (e.g. from a cross-reference). Do NOT call this tool repeatedly to search for provisions â use get_law_text instead to fetch the full act or a section and locate relevant articles in the text.

rs_number.description: RS/SR number (e.g. '210' for CC, '220' for CO, '311.0' for CP)

date.description: Consolidation date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to the latest available version.

tools.name: get_law_text
tools.description: Retrieve the official consolidated text of a Swiss federal act (or a specific title/chapter) directly from Fedlex (fedlex.admin.ch). This is the PRIMARY tool for answering Swiss law questions â always start here. Fetch the full act or a specific section, then locate relevant provisions in the returned text. Prefer this over get_article unless you already know the exact article number.

rs_number.description: RS/SR number (e.g. '210' for CC, '220' for CO)

section.description: Limit to a specific title, chapter, or part (e.g. 'Titre huitiÃ¨me', 'Zweiter Teil'). If omitted, returns the full act.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (default: 1). Large acts are split across multiple pages.

tools.name: list_amendments
tools.description: List consolidation version dates for a Swiss federal act. Returns the dates each consolidated version took effect.

since.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: 1 year ago)
